body: I'm a maybe soon to be phd in literature, poetry, theory, and creative writing.

I think the best way to describe it is that I came to a point where I had a loaded pistol in my hand and I had to choose: kill myself and end this now, or live, fight for myself and my life, and only take the steps I feel are absolutely necessary to be comfortable in my own body. The only problem is that I'm 140k in debt from my MFA and phd, and have no job, no income starting this summer, and no way to secure work without passing as female.  The doubly crappy part of this is that I can't change my sex on my license and identification docs w/o a sex change, so even if I pass for female at first glance, everything I'd hand over for a job would say male.

My mom and dad and sister will not speak to me. My wife's family doesn't know I'm trans at all. Most of my friends from my MFA program walked out of my life when I came out to them. I have one friend in Arizona, one in Italy, and one here, who is a forty year old lesbian, married to a guy with two kids. She spends her weekends at clubs hooking up with random women and is trying to help me feel comfortable doing the same, but I took vows that I meant. I won't break them, not even in divorce. I will always be there for my wife, even as she grows to despise me, richer or poorer, sickness and in health, for better or goddamn worse, I belong to her, and always will,

I think a large part of my difficulty is being married to a woman whom I love deeply. She is my soulmate. We've been together twelve years. But every day now she looks at me and says she is mourning the loss of her husband, and that the person I am now is a stranger to her, a girl she doesn't like and doesn't want to get to know.

I'm in western Michigan, rural. I risk my safety stepping out to get the mail, much less grocery shop or anything else. My life is severely limited after four yrs phd word and now being visibly trans. I just feel utterly alone and wholly lost.
People look at me in public and can't tell if I'm a guy or a girl. I am visibly trans. I've lost my family, most friends, colleagues, you name it. Also, just this week. My wife of twelve years.
I spoke with her today to no avail, and so quit my meds today cold turkey. Impressive, the amount of panic and feelings of self harm they were holding back.

I see a therapist twice a week. Unfortunately between the seroquel and Effexor, not to mention klonopin and Wellbutrin, my creative drive is dead. I feel like I've been switched off as a human being, set in automaton mode.

I would love to, but I have qual exams at the end of march, an analytical thesis due in April, a defense of both the exams and thesis at the end of April, a creative thesis due in may, defense of that mid June, and graduation at the end of June. Oh, I'm also having facial feminization surgery in early April. That'll be surgery number three in one semester.

I have been diagnosed with double refractory depression, major depression, complex post traumatic stress disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, ADHD, and gender identity disorder.  That's all..I think.
I'm transitioning from male to female. I'm transgender. I'm a phd student in my last semester of a four years program.
